title: Broken Disguise
text:
Symphony X - Revelation <<< Click if you want to listen...

"Against the wall - they see you
nowhere to run, nowhere to hide

Heroic Mask - the cracks are showing
a Faceless God to shape the Perfect Lie

Wounds of Hate have pierced so deep
they never die - my revenge is bitter-sweet

Lost in the night wandering alone
Try as I might to escape the fight
It never lets me go - I've got to find a way
A way to Rise above it All

Saviour or the Fool - the mystery
fades into the cruel shade of night

This broken disguise can not comprehend
what was, and will be...until the very end

Wounds of Hate have pierced so deep
they never die - my revenge is bitter-sweet

Lost in the night wandering alone
Try as I might to escape the fight
It never lets me go - I've got to find a way
A way to Rise above it All

...oh, where the North Wind sleeps - that is when
we'll meet again...oh, where the shadows creep
into Twilight, I'll descend
Good and Evil, it never ends
You're just a means to an end

Lost in the night wandering alone
Try as I might to escape the fight
It never lets me go - I've got to find a way
A way to Rise above it All"

title: The Fog
text:
Hi, Today's upload was laying on my hard drive for some time, but every artwork needs a viewer. Every artwork needs a comment for the artist to improve. Whenever you say something you expect reply or a silence (deliberation). The same is with art - don't say pointless things, think things out. 'Don't rush and be patient' - I am constantly repeating to myself. These conclusions influenced the process, which I am discovering right now. My conception of painting is changing.

I have attached these thoughts under this piece, because it was one of the first to provoke myself to switch point of view. I would say it is a breakthrough in my mind rather than quality or result. The theme was imposed by a contest at The Gnomon Workshop Forum. 

I hope you enjoy it.

Mateusz Ozminski
